question:
You will be shown several images captured during a robotic manipulation task.
Each image comes with a description of the camera position from which it was taken.
Please use this information to help answer the following question.


Image 1 (fix_center): The center fixed camera captures this front-facing view of the manipulation scene.


Image 2 (ego_right): This image was captured from a wrist-mounted camera on the robot's right arm.


Image 3 (ego_left): The left wrist camera captures this egocentric view of the robotic operation.


A robotic manipulation task is shown across these 3 images.
While most images capture the same moment, one image was taken at a different time.
Pay attention to subtle differences in the scene that indicate temporal displacement.
Which image number represents the time-mismatched frame?
